sloka: भित्वा वेलाम् समुद्रस्य लोकान् आप्लावयेत् विभुः ।वेगम् वा अपि समुद्रस्य वाअयुम् वा विधमेत् शरैः ॥३-३१-२५॥
transliteration: bhitvā velām samudrasya lokān āplāvayet vibhuḥ ।vegam vā api samudrasya vāayum vā vidhamet śaraiḥ ॥3-31-25॥

translations.english: He is so very powerful that he can drown the earth by breaking the boundary of the sea. He can arrest the speed of the sea or of the wind with his arrows.
